SOCIAL STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   C. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.

   C. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
